comment: QR targets of the slides (tools/qr-links.ts). `text` is what a slide prints: the short domain people can type. `qr` is what the code opens: the pages themselves on GitVerse, which stays reachable when a network lets only listed domains through (med.1damer.com's DNS is on Cloudflare). Change a value and run `bun docs/promo/diary-presentation/tools/qr-links.ts` from the repository root.
